title: Personalized Recovery Plans
description: Implement an AI-powered adaptive recovery planning system that automatically detects weak biology topics from quiz/assessment performance and generates personalized remediation plans with adaptive quizzes, guided remediation flows, spaced review recommendations, and mastery tracking.

userStories.title: Weak Topic Detection
userStories.description: As a student, I want weak biology topics identified from my assessment performance so that I know what to improve.
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz and assessment scores analyzed automatically after completion
Subtopic-level weaknesses detected and scored (not just overall score)
Weak topics displayed with severity scores and confidence metrics
Misconception patterns detected from repeated mistakes and hint usage
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend analysis logic. Requires new database tables: student_mastery, misconception_patterns.

userStories.title: AI Recovery Plan Generation
userStories.description: As a student, I want personalized recovery plans generated automatically when I score below 60% on a unit, so that I can improve efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Recovery plan auto-triggered when unit score < 60% or repeated failures detected
Plan includes topic-specific remediation tasks ordered by intelligence
Tasks can include: review notes, guided quizzes, diagram exercises, retake assessments
Plan adapts difficulty based on weakness severity
Plans stored and retrievable via API
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: RecoveryAgent in src/agents/recovery_agent.py extends BaseAgent, generates plans from weak topics via LLM. Endpoint: POST /recovery/auto-generate/{user_id}. Task types: review_notes, guided_quiz, diagram_exercise, retake_assessment, practice_questions.

userStories.title: Recovery Dashboard
userStories.description: As a student, I want a dedicated recovery dashboard so that I can track my weaknesses and improvement clearly in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard accessible from main navigation
Displays weak topics list with mastery percentages
Shows active recovery plan with task timeline
Shows recommended quizzes and review schedule
Shows AI-generated recommendations
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: New dashboard page/component. Requires RP-001 and RP-002 for data.

userStories.title: Adaptive Quiz Recommendation
userStories.description: As a student, I want targeted quizzes focused on my weak areas so that I can practice effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz difficulty adapts based on current mastery level
Quiz content focuses on detected weak subtopics
Recommendations update dynamically after each completed quiz
Quiz completion triggers re-evaluation of topic mastery
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: Enhances existing quiz agent with adaptive difficulty and weakness targeting. Requires RP-001.

userStories.title: Recovery Progress Tracking
userStories.description: As a student, I want my recovery progress tracked over time so that I can measure improvement.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress percentages visible per topic on dashboard
Mastery scores update automatically after each completed task or quiz
Topic improvement tracked over time with history
Mastery data persisted in topic_mastery_history table
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: New table: topic_mastery_history. Integrates with gamification XP system via recovery_task_completion source.

userStories.title: Spaced Repetition Scheduling
userStories.description: As a student, I want review reminders so that I retain biology concepts over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Review intervals generated based on topic mastery and retention decay
Reminder schedule stored in spaced_repetition_schedule table
Repeat practice tasks appear on dashboard when due for review
Intervals adapt based on re-assessment performance
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: New table: spaced_repetition_schedule. Schedule logic in src/agents/spaced_repetition.py (SM-2 inspired algorithm). Review intervals update dynamically based on mastery score.

userStories.title: Recovery Notifications
userStories.description: As a student, I want motivational progress notifications so that I stay engaged with my recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifications triggered when topic mastery improves significantly
Messages highlight milestone improvements (e.g., 'You improved 18% in Cell Biology')
Messaging is supportive and encouraging, avoids negative wording
Notifications appear in chat and dashboard
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: Notification logic in weak_topic_detection.py (_generate_improvement_notification). Display in dashboard (notifications panel in recovery page) and chat (Telegram bot _fetch_recovery_notifications + _format_notification_messages). Three event types: mastery_improvement, severity_upgrade, plan_completed.
